theater: 滎陽大海寺（河南滎陽東北）

battle.name: 大海寺之戰
battle.theater: 滎陽大海寺（河南滎陽東北）
battle.brief: 大業十二年十月，李密勸翟讓先取滎陽，瓦崗軍破金堤關攻諸縣。隋煬帝徙張須陀為滎陽通守，率精銳萬餘來討。張須陀輕敵，方陣追擊十餘里，李密預伏千餘人於大海寺北林間，掩發合圍，張須陀躍馬回身死鬥，隋軍大潰。瓦崗軍乘勝據滎陽取糧倉。卡面亞述長矛雖未隨軍而至，隋軍陣前的長槊正是其傳承。

kit.name: 亞述長矛
kit.history: 短柄、長刃，配著鐵鏃。亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。

countries: 大海寺之戰是隋朝與瓦崗軍在滎陽東北方的一次野戰，時間在大業十二年十月。隋方以朝廷任命的滎陽通守張須陀為主將，他同時掛著河南道十二郡討捕大使的頭銜，是隋廷平定河北、河南群盜的柱石，手中握有精銳萬餘，裝備精良，編制上仍沿用隋軍以大旗分隊、方陣推進的舊法，郡縣提供的人夫、糧秣、器械則靠汴水漕運線就地輸送。瓦崗軍一方是東都法曹翟讓聚起的部眾，起初不過數千人，靠在滎陽、梁郡一帶劫掠汴水上的商船自資，是典型的流寇型武裝；自李密歸附並被推為蒲山公之後，瓦崗軍才有了明確的進取方向與漸臻完整的指揮系統，下設正兵與分兵，由翟讓、單雄信、徐世勣、王伯當等分領。兩軍的分野並非單純的朝廷與叛軍：瓦崗軍繳獲的糧秣、繳用的船隻，多來自隋朝自己的漕運與郡縣；而隋軍一旦在野戰中失利，郡縣就失去替他們守城的意願，這正是《資治通鑑》所說「河南郡縣為之喪氣」的真正含義。交戰雙方在豫州、兗州一帶的地面上重疊，一方要保汴水漕運與洛陽倉，另一方要靠攻下郡城取得存糧，這一戰正是兩個體系爭奪河南的起點。
countriesEn: The Battle of Dahai Temple was a field engagement between the Sui dynasty and the Wagang Army north-east of Xingyang, fought in the tenth month of the twelfth year of the Daye era, in 616. On the Sui side the field army was commanded by Zhang Xutuo, whom the court had transferred to serve as Tongshou, the military governor of Xingyang; Zhang also carried the title of Duobu Dashishi, the commander for the suppression of bandits over the twelve prefectures of Henan, and he was the pillar on which the Sui court relied to hold down the rebels of Hebei and Henan. He had under him a picked force of more than ten thousand, well equipped, organised in the old Sui manner into units marked out by great banners and advanced in square formation, while the labour, provisions and matériel for the campaign still came from the prefectures and towns and moved north along the Bian River grain route. On the Wagang side stood the followers gathered by Zhai Rang, a judicial officer of the eastern capital who had begun with a few thousand men and lived off what they could seize from merchant boats on the Bian at Xingyang and Liang prefecture, the typical equipment of a roving armed band; only after Li Mi had joined them and been raised to the title of Duke of Pushan did the Wagang army acquire a clear direction of advance and a command structure that grew steadily more complete, with a main body and detached columns entrusted to Zhai Rang, Shan Xiongxin, Xu Shiji and Wang Baodang. The dividing line between the two sides was not simply court against rebels: much of the grain, money and shipping that sustained the Wagang army had been taken from the Sui's own river transport and its prefectural stores, and once the Sui army lost a field battle the prefectures lost all taste for holding cities on its behalf, which is the real meaning of the remark in the Zizhi Tongjian that the commanderies and counties of Henan were disheartened by the result. The two systems overlapped on the ground in Yuzhou and Yanzhou: one had to guard the Bian River transport and the Luoyang granaries, the other had to take the commandery cities in order to obtain stores, and this battle was the opening move in the contest for Henan.
people: 瓦崗軍的領袖翟讓是韋城人，原任東都法曹，因事當斬，獄吏黃君漢見其驍勇，夜半破械放他出獄，翟讓遂亡命瓦崗，聚眾為盜。他勇而少謀，先前平定河南數十萬群盜的張須陀多次擊敗他，《資治通鑑》記翟讓「向數為須陀所敗」，所以一聽張須陀到來便打算躲避。關鍵人物是李密：他出身蒲山公之家，禮部尚書楊玄感起兵時他曾參與其事，兵敗後輾轉逃亡，先依郝孝德、再依王薄，窮到削樹皮為食，後來在梁、宋之間得房彥藻引見；見到翟讓時以「劉、項皆起布衣為帝王」勸他席捲二京、誅滅暴虐，又以「先取滎陽，休兵館谷」取代四處遊擊的方略，瓦崗軍從此才有了進取的方向。謀劃此戰的還有賈雄，他通曉陰陽占候，充當翟讓的軍師，替李密說話；王伯當是引李密見翟讓的關係人，與徐世勣同樣在合圍張須陀時指揮一翼；單雄信是翟讓同郡的驍將，驍健善用馬槊。隋方除張須陀外，鷹揚郎將賈務本為其副手，戰負重傷後率餘眾五千餘人奔梁郡，不久身死；滎陽太守郇王慶不能討賊，朝廷才把張須陀調來；大敗之後，詔以光祿大夫裴仁基為河南道討捕大使，代領其眾，鎮虎牢，接上這條被打斷的防線。
peopleEn: The leader of the Wagang army was Zhai Rang, a native of Weicheng and originally a judicial officer of the eastern capital. Awaiting execution over some matter, he was seen by the clerk Huang Junhan, who was struck by his courage, broke his fetters and let him out of the prison in the night; Zhai then fled to Wagang and gathered a band of outlaws. He was brave but short of strategy, and Zhang Xutuo, who had brought tens of thousands of rebels in Henan to heel, had beaten him repeatedly; the Zizhi Tongjian records that Zhai Rang had often been defeated by Xutuo before, and so at the news of Xutuo's approach he wanted to avoid the fight altogether. The pivotal figure was Li Mi. The son of the Duke of Pushan, he had taken part in the rising of the Minister of Rites Yang Xuangan and, after that rebellion collapsed, wandered as a fugitive, first under Hao Xiaode and then under Wang Bo, so reduced that he ate the bark of trees; later, between Liang and Song he was introduced by Fang Yanzao. Meeting Zhai Rang, he urged him with the words that Liu Bang and Xiang Yu had both risen from commoners to become emperors, telling him to sweep up the two capitals and destroy the tyranny, and he replaced the plan of raiding here and there with the formula of taking Xingyang first, resting the troops and feasting them on the grain of that place, so that the Wagang army acquired a direction of advance. Two others helped to plan the battle: Jia Xiong, who understood yin-yang and divination and served as Zhai Rang's military adviser, spoke on Li Mi's behalf; Wang Baodang, through whom Li Mi was presented to Zhai Rang, and Xu Shiji each commanded a wing of the encirclement of Zhang Xutuo. Shan Xiongxin, a fellow townsman of Zhai Rang, was a valiant general strong and agile in the use of the horse lance. On the Sui side, apart from Zhang Xutuo himself, the Eagle-Soaring Langjiang Jia Wuben was his deputy; wounded in the fighting he led more than five thousand of the remaining men off to Liang prefecture and died shortly after. The governor of Xingyang, Prince Xun Qing, could not suppress the rebels, and only then was Zhang Xutuo transferred to the city. After the defeat the court appointed the Director of Ceremonies Pei Renji as commander for the suppression of bandits over Henan, gave him command of the broken troops, and stationed him at Hulao to take over the line that had been cut.
kits: 卡面這件亞述長矛，是公元前九百年上下亞述軍隊所用的短柄長刃鐵矛，配鐵鏃，與弓、斧、盾結合成步兵的骨架；它早於本場戰役一千五百餘年，卻是兩河流域最早把「持矛的密集步兵」推成戰役主力的兵器形制，而這一套形制沿著歐亞大陸一路東傳，最終成為漢地軍隊長矛、槊一系的源頭。隋軍的正面骨幹正是長槊：史家形容隋軍密集的槊陣為「長槊如林」，方陣之內以長槊與重弩相配，近身處以刀盾結陣，前鋒列槊如林而後以弩矢覆蓋，張須陀方陣前進、追擊十餘里的作戰方式，正是靠槊陣的正面厚度與騎兵的追躡維持。瓦崗軍一方則以輕兵、步卒與少量騎兵為主，裝備多為劫掠來的郡縣兵器與漕船上的物資，未必有成套重甲與長槊，但熟悉汴水兩岸的道路與村落，慣於分散突擊、倏合倏散。攻城與後勤器具同樣要緊：瓦崗軍先破金堤關、攻下滎陽諸縣，再圖郡城，正是要取城中的糧倉；隋軍的補給則靠汴水漕運，那些船隻才是戰役真正的隱形戰場，兵員、弓弩、箭矢、食糧都靠它們北運。單雄信以善用馬槊聞名，亦可見馬槊這一兵種在河南地方武力中的分量。
kitsEn: The Assyrian spear on the card is an iron spear of short shaft and long blade with an iron socketed head, as used by Assyrian troops around the ninth century before the common era, tied together with the bow, the axe and the shield to form the skeleton of the infantry. It predates this battle by more than fifteen hundred years, yet it is the weapon type through which the densely speared infantry of Mesopotamia was first made the backbone of a battle, and that type of formation travelled east across Eurasia until it became the ancestor of the long spear and the mao of Chinese armies. The front bone of the Sui army was precisely the long spear: historians described the packed spear ranks of the Sui as a forest of long spears, the square formation pairing long spears with heavy crossbows and closing with knives and shields at contact range, the front rank standing spear upon spear while crossbow volleys covered them, and the way Zhang Xutuo advanced in square order and pursued for more than ten li depended on the thickness of that spear front and on the mounted men following up the rout. The Wagang army fought with light infantry, footsoldiers and a small number of horsemen, equipped largely with weapons taken from the plundered commandery cities and with goods found on the grain boats; they may not have had matched armour and long spears in sets, but they knew the roads and villages along both banks of the Bian and were used to striking in dispersed order and closing and breaking away in a moment. Siege and baggage equipment mattered just as much: the Wagang army first broke through Jindi Pass and took the counties of Xingyang before turning on the commandery city, precisely in order to get at the granary inside it, while the Sui army was kept supplied by the Bian River transport, those boats being the real invisible battlefield of the campaign, since men, crossbows, arrows and grain all moved north on them. The renown of Shan Xiongxin for the horse lance also shows what weight that arm of the service carried in the local forces of Henan.
tactics: 大海寺一戰的關鍵，是李密選在大海寺北面的林間設伏。張須陀到任後，見翟讓屢敗而輕敵，方陳而前，以方陣展開正面推進；翟讓接戰不利，佯敗退走，張須陀果然乘勝追擊，一氣追出十餘里，隊伍被拉長，陣形鬆散，側翼暴露。李密預先分兵千餘人埋伏於大海寺北林間，等追兵進入林中，掩發而出，一擊而合圍。此時瓦崗軍的布署是李密、翟讓合兵與徐世勣、王伯當各部合圍，把隋軍困在林間空地；張須陀一度衝出重圍，部下的左右騎衛卻沒能全部跟出，他躍馬再入回陣，往來衝殺四趟，終於戰死。隋軍崩潰之後，部將相告以盡，士卒晝夜號哭，數日不止，連其後歸附的郡縣也為之氣沮。隋軍的教訓在於：方陣追擊一旦越出隊形，槊陣的縱深與相互掩護就全部失效，密林正是伏兵最好的地形。瓦崗軍的取勝之道則是反覆使用同一套辦法——誘敵深入、預設伏兵、以多打少，收兵之後不戀戰、不追遠，立即轉向取城取糧，後勤先於戰果。
tacticsEn: The key to the battle at Dahai Temple was that Li Mi chose to set his ambush in the woods north of the temple. After taking up his post, Zhang Xutuo, contemptuous of a Zhai Rang who had already been beaten so many times, came on in square formation and advanced in order. Zhai's men were worsted in the first contact and gave way, and Xutuo duly took the bait and pursued, riding hard for more than ten li, so that his column was drawn out, his formation loosened and his flanks left exposed. Li Mi had already split off more than a thousand men to lie in ambush in the woods north of Dahai Temple; as the pursuing column entered the trees the ambush burst out, and in a single stroke the Sui army was surrounded. The Wagang deployment was then Li Mi, Zhai Rang and the columns of Xu Shiji and Wang Baodang closing in together and penned the Sui troops in the open ground between the trees. Zhang Xutuo broke out of the ring once, but not all of his guards at his sides could follow him out; he leapt onto his horse again and re-entered the fight, charging back and forth four times before he was killed. After the Sui army broke up its officers could only announce the end, and the soldiers cried and wailed day and night for several days, so that even the commanderies which later submitted were disheartened. The lesson for the Sui was that once a square formation in pursuit outruns its own order, the depth and mutual support of the spear ranks are all lost, and thick woodland is the best of ambush terrain. The Wagang method, by contrast, was to repeat one formula: draw the enemy deep in, set the ambush beforehand, and bring superior numbers down on him, and then, once the fighting was over, to stand neither and pursue no further but turn at once upon the city and its grain, logistics before spoils.
data: 可用的數字大半出自《資治通鑑》卷一百八十三。翟讓聚眾之初「聚徒至萬餘人」，那是瓦崗軍起家的規模；到本戰時，瓦崗軍已發展為河南最強的一支變民軍，部眾當在數萬之眾。隋軍方面，張須陀所部為「精銳萬餘」；李密分出的伏兵是「千餘人」；追擊的距離是「十餘里」；賈務本帶走的餘眾是「五千餘人」；張須陀戰死之後，所部士卒「晝夜號哭，數日不止」。時間上，戰事在大業十二年十月，庚戌日接戰，自起兵到勝負分明總共不過數日。地理上，金堤關、滎陽諸縣、大海寺北林與滎陽郡城彼此相去不過一日路程，軍隊在這些點之間移動完全依賴步行與汴水船運。數字之中最能說明問題的是糧：瓦崗軍此前「公士眾雖多，食無倉稟，唯資野掠」，全靠劫船維持，攻下滎陽取得糧倉之後才第一次有了穩定的存糧；次年李密乘勝攻入洛陽興洛倉，《資治通鑑》記載盡取其米二百四十萬石，正是這場大海寺勝利積累出來的底子。相對而言，隋廷在同一時期對河北山東用兵、對高句麗用兵，兵員分散，滎陽一地的精銳就這樣被吃掉。
dataEn: Most of the usable figures come from volume one hundred and eighty-three of the Zizhi Tongjian. When Zhai Rang first gathered his followers he had 'gathered a crowd of more than ten thousand', and that was the scale at which the Wagang army began; by the time of this battle it had grown into the strongest band of insurgents in Henan, with a following that must by then have run to tens of thousands. On the Sui side Zhang Xutuo's force was 'a picked ten thousand and more'; the ambush that Li Mi detached was 'more than a thousand men'; the distance of the pursuit was 'more than ten li'; the remnant that Jia Wuben carried off was 'more than five thousand men'; and after Zhang Xutuo was killed the soldiers of his command 'cried and wailed day and night for several days'. In time, the fighting took place in the tenth month of the twelfth year of Daye, the two sides joining battle on the gengxu day, and from the first move to the decision it took no more than a few days. In geography, Jindi Pass, the counties of Xingyang, the woods north of Dahai Temple and the commandery city of Xingyang lay within a day's march of one another, and the movement of troops between these points depended entirely on walking and on the boats of the Bian. Of all the figures, the most telling is that of grain. The Wagang army had previously been in the situation where 'though its soldiers and the commons were numerous, it had no granaries and no stores, and lived only on what it could seize in the fields'; only after taking Xingyang and its granary did it have stable reserves for the first time. In the following year Li Mi rode that success into the Xingluo granary at Luoyang and, as the Zizhi Tongjian records, took all of its two million four hundred thousand hu of rice, which was the foundation the victory at Dahai Temple had built. By contrast, the Sui court was simultaneously fighting in Hebei and Shandong and at war with Goguryeo, its soldiers scattered; the picked troops of a single place like Xingyang were thus consumed.
cause: 此戰的起因是糧，不是什麼大義名分。大業年間，隋煬帝三次征高句麗，役丁、轉糧，天下疲敝，盜賊蜂起；翟讓本是東都法曹，因事待斬，獄吏黃君漢夜放他出獄，他便亡命瓦崗，靠同郡單雄信與衛南少年徐世勣的提議，轉向汴水沿線劫掠舟船，把搶來的錢糧當作軍資，既能「資用豐給」，依附者也就益眾。真正讓瓦崗軍改弦更張的是李密的到來。他看出「四海糜沸，不得耕耘，公士眾雖多，食無倉稟，唯資野掠，常苦不給」，若曠日持久又遇大敵臨前，部眾必至渙散，於是勸翟讓先取滎陽、休兵館谷，等士馬肥充再與人爭利。翟讓從之，於是破金堤關、攻滎陽諸縣，把戰線一直推到洛陽東面的郡城之下。滎陽扼汴水漕運、鄰近洛陽倉，是隋廷在河南的糧食樞紐；守郡的郇王慶不能討賊，朝廷才徙張須陀為滎陽通守討之。於是本為糧道與漕運之爭的一場衝突，終於在大海寺前變成了兩軍的遭遇戰。
causeEn: The cause of this battle was grain, not any lofty claim. Through the years of the Daye era the Emperor Yang of Sui had campaigned against Goguryeo three times, conscripting labour and shifting grain, so that the realm was exhausted and bandits rose everywhere. Zhai Rang was a judicial officer of the eastern capital awaiting execution when the clerk Huang Junhan released him in the night; he fled to Wagang and, on the advice of his fellow townsman Shan Xiongxin and of the youth Xu Shiji of Weinan, turned to seizing boats along the Bian, taking the money and grain thus taken as the supply of his band, so that 'resources were abundant' and those who joined increased. What truly changed the Wagang army was the arrival of Li Mi. He saw that 'all under heaven is in ferment, the fields cannot be sown, and though the soldiers and commons are numerous there are no granaries and stores, and they live only on plunder, and are constantly short of what they need'; if this went on for long and a great enemy came upon them, the ranks would certainly scatter. He therefore urged Zhai Rang to take Xingyang first, rest the troops and feed them there, and only contend with others once the soldiers and horses were fat and strong. Zhai agreed, broke through Jindi Pass, took the counties of Xingyang, and pushed the line of battle right up to the commandery city east of Luoyang. Xingyang commanded the Bian River transport and lay near the Luoyang granaries; it was the hinge of the court's food supply in Henan. The governor of the city, Prince Xun Qing, could not master the rebels, and only then was Zhang Xutuo transferred to be Tongshou of Xingyang to deal with them. Thus a struggle that in truth was over the grain road and the river transport came at last to a meeting of the two armies before Dahai Temple.
impact: 大海寺一役在隋末的分量，重在它把瓦崗軍從流寇改造成有根據地的軍隊。張須陀一死，隋廷在河南唯一能打的柱石傾覆，裴仁基接手後鎮虎牢，只能固守而無力進取；《資治通鑑》說河南郡縣為之喪氣，意思是郡縣不再願意替朝廷守城，也不再相信官軍還能回來。瓦崗軍則乘勝攻下滎陽城，取得糧倉，士卒第一次吃上飽飯，軍隊由「唯資野掠」的流動狀態轉為有屯糧、有城守的正規化方向。次年李密乘勢攻入洛陽興洛倉，一舉取得二百四十萬石米，瓦崗軍的規模與戰力自此壓過河南其他各部，成為爭取中原的主要力量。人事上的後果更為深遠：此戰之後翟讓讓李密建牙別統所部，號薄山公營，李密得以自成一軍，兩人的權力分立就此埋下伏筆；不到一年之後，瓦崗內部為權位反目，李密誅殺翟讓而獨掌其眾，一場原本可能團結的起義就此裂為內爭。從更大的背景看，隋廷在河南的崩解加速了它在江都的崩潰，兩年後煬帝遇弒，隋朝覆亡；而大海寺這個地名，則成為瓦崗軍的起點被人記住。
impactEn: The weight of the battle of Dahai Temple in the history of the late Sui lies in the fact that it turned the Wagang army from a roving band into an army with a base. With the death of Zhang Xutuo the single pillar on which the Sui court relied in Henan collapsed; Pei Renji took over and was stationed at Hulao, able to hold fast but not to advance. The Zizhi Tongjian's remark that the commanderies and counties of Henan were disheartened means that the counties no longer wished to hold cities for the court and no longer believed the government troops would come back. The Wagang army, for its part, rode the victory to take the city of Xingyang and the granary within it, and the soldiers ate their fill for the first time; the army passed from the mobile condition of living only on plunder to a regularised direction with stored grain and city defences. In the following year Li Mi pressed on into the Xingluo granary at Luoyang and seized two million four hundred thousand hu of rice, and from then on the size and the fighting power of the Wagang army weighed more than those of every other band in Henan, making it the main force contending for the Central Plain. The consequences in the field of personnel were deeper still. After this battle Zhai Rang let Li Mi set up his own banner and command a division separately, styling himself the camp of the Duke of Pushan, so that Li Mi could stand as a force in his own right, and the division of authority between the two men was sown from that moment; in less than a year the Wagang camp fell out over rank and power, Li Mi killed Zhai Rang and took sole command, and an uprising that might have held together was split by internal strife. On a larger horizon, the collapse of Sui authority in Henan hastened its collapse at Jiangdu, and two years later the Emperor Yang was killed and the Sui dynasty destroyed. The name of Dahai Temple, meanwhile, was remembered as the starting point of the Wagang army.
result: 此役的結局，隋軍是全敗：李密與翟讓及徐世勣、王伯當合軍圍之，張須陀突圍而出又躍馬回身死鬥，往來四衝終至戰死，部兵潰散，賈務本負重傷率五千餘人奔梁郡，不久亦卒，所部士卒晝夜號哭數日。瓦崗軍則完勝，贏得的不只是戰場：乘勝攻占滎陽城，奪取糧倉，取得可以養兵的實力；李密隨即以蒲山公之名建牙，別統所部，部眾與器械都得到補充，瓦崗軍的戰略重心由「席捲二京」的宣言轉為實實在在的據城、屯糧、擴軍。對隋朝而言，張須陀之死是比丟失一座郡城更嚴重的損失：河南十二郡的討捕使從此再沒有一個能單獨扭轉局面的人，裴仁基接任之後也只做到守住虎牢，隋廷在中原的軍事主動權就此易手。此戰之後，瓦崗軍在河南的地位再沒有被挑戰，李密於次年攻取洛陽興洛倉，兵精糧足，最終成為逐鹿中原最有力的那股力量；而大海寺這個地名，也就成了隋末以弱勝強、伏兵破方的代表戰例，被後世反覆講述。
resultEn: The outcome of the campaign was a complete Sui defeat. Li Mi, Zhai Rang and the columns of Xu Shiji and Wang Baodang closed in together upon Zhang Xutuo; he broke out of the ring, leapt back onto his horse and fought to the death, charging in and out four times before he was killed, his troops disintegrating, while Jia Wuben, grievously wounded, led more than five thousand men off to Liang prefecture and died soon after, and the soldiers of the defeated army cried and wailed day and night for days. The Wagang army won outright, and its gain was not merely the field: riding the victory it seized the city of Xingyang and the granary there, obtaining the means to feed an army; Li Mi at once raised the banner of the Duke of Pushan and commanded a separate division, the ranks and the weapons of the army being filled out, and the strategic centre of gravity of the Wagang army shifting from the proclamation of sweeping up the two capitals to the plain business of holding cities, storing grain and expanding. For the Sui the death of Zhang Xutuo was a heavier loss than the fall of a single commandery city: from that day there was no longer in Henan a commander for the suppression of bandits who could turn the situation alone, and Pei Renji after him achieved no more than the holding of Hulao, so that the military initiative in the Central Plain passed out of Sui hands. After this battle the position of the Wagang army in Henan was never again challenged; Li Mi took the Xingluo granary at Luoyang in the following year, well armed and well fed, and became at last the strongest force in the struggle for the Central Plain. Dahai Temple, for its part, became the standing example of a small band defeating a great army by ambush in the late Sui, told and retold after that.
